name: RBC Bearings
outlook:
What RBC Bearings says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: net salesCompany expects net sales to be approximately $520.0 million to $525.0 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2027, compared to $461.6 million in the prior year, for a growth rate of 12.7% to 13.7%.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: gross margin and SG&AGross margin is expected to be in the range of 45.5% to 45.75% and SG&A as a percentage of net sales is expected to be in the range of 16.25% to 16.5%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
